requirement.summary: Shadow patches implement bounded JSON Merge Patch with exact version authority and atomic rejection.
Offline commands retain a frozen payload, expiry, desired version and stable delivery identity in canonical poll order.
Receipt and sequence identities replay or conflict exactly while reported projection remains monotonic.
Campaigns freeze valid active members and require matching firmware acknowledgement for target success.
DeploymentWave creation and controls expose only the closed Wave contract and reject invalid partitions atomically.
Concurrent desired CAS and shuffled receipts converge without arrival-order overwrite or terminal regression.
Lost responses, concurrency and restart replay one original status, body, identity and durable effect.
Create a real frozen Wave, add a Device afterward, and compare actual Wave members, binding fields and partition with the saved creation response. Automatic health adjudication is not asserted.
Concurrent pause, resume and cancel preserve terminal members and converge to one legal aggregate state.
Rollback freezes only successful members and creates one prior-firmware compensation per affected device.
Claimed command dispatch and expiry Work survives SIGKILL while database terminal state fences stale delivery.
Claimed receipt projection recovers immutable shuffled evidence without duplicate patch or stale overwrite.

Kill a claimed UPGRADE_FANOUT worker and drain its replacement; verify unique target and command per frozen Campaign device. This case does not claim compensation or automatic health-gated advancement.
Unknown dispatcher acknowledgements retry stable event identity, canonical body and aggregate order without tenant or secret leakage.
OpenAPI and runtime close the exact V1 and DeploymentWave methods, shapes, errors and legacy boundary.
Real Chromium completes shadow, offline command, receipt and Campaign controls against public HTTP.
Real Chromium controls Wave state and exposes frozen members, prior firmware and unique compensation lineage.
Authenticated snapshots form one tenant-scoped point in time across shadows, commands, receipts, targets, waves, Work and Events.
The full 100000-device desired and reported patch workload meets published throughput and latency with complete replay reconciliation.
The full 50000-command online/offline expiry workload meets thresholds and closes delivery, identity and terminal invariants.
The full 10000-device upgrade backlog recovers two killed workers within sixty seconds and closes every target and receipt.

Exercise only the current public API and legal seed on one FINAL submission; verify durable business state, identity and replay without historical binary, old database or synthetic migration-only wrappers.
